Package com.csse3200.game.cards.effects

Interface CardEffectResultStore

All Known Implementing Classes:
TurnEffectStore
public interface CardEffectResultStore
Read-only query boundary for resolved card effects recorded during the current turn.

Team 1 and Team 7 can consume these results without depending on Team 5's resolver or calculation state. Implementations store resolution data only and do not mutate player or enemy entities.
